how: Hash the leaf file with SHA-256(0x00 || bytes), then fold the audit path in order with SHA-256(0x01 || left || right), RFC 6962. The result must equal `root`, which is the value the signed checkpoint carries.
scope: Proves this entry is in the tree whose root is named here. It does not prove the entry is true, and it cannot see a history shown to somebody else: that is what the witness is for.
